title: Lawry’s Seasoning Clone
steps: Process in food processor or blender for 10-15 seconds to mix and break down the crystal size of the salt and sugar. The final mixture should be a fine texture but not powdered.
Store in a tightly sealed container. The blend improves over time as the flavor from the seasonings meld together.
headnote: A sweet and salty all-purpose seasoning blend for everyday cooking and barbecue.
